mapper.sql: p.promo_status = 1 AND p.promo_price IS NOT NULL AND (p.promo_start_time IS NULL OR p.promo_start_time <= NOW()) AND (p.promo_end_time IS NULL OR p.promo_end_time >= NOW())
CASE WHEN THEN p.promo_price ELSE p.price END
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_favorite (user_id, product_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, product_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.brand_id, b.name AS brand_name, p.category_id, p.category, AS price, CASE WHEN THEN p.price ELSE p.original_price END AS original_price, p.price AS base_price, p.stock, p.description, p.image_url, p.images, p.specs, p.status, p.merchant_id, p.sales_count, p.view_count, p.promo_price, p.promo_start_time, p.promo_end_time, p.promo_status, CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS promo_active, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM user_favorite uf JOIN product p ON uf.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN brand b ON p.brand_id = b.id WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uf.created_at DESC
